validationLimits: These materials cover the sharp native image libraries and build recipes, plus the explicitly identified ONNX Runtime Eigen source dependency. They are not an archive for every component in the desktop application.
A complete rebuild or byte-identical comparison of rebuilt outputs has not been performed. No reproducible-build or general license-clearance claim is made.

The upstream base Dockerfile names MXE branch llvm-mingw-20260924 and an unpinned Debian base image. The recorded MXE commit is the branch resolution when collected; exact historical OCI image digest and host tools are not established.
Build recipes for system tools and bootstrap downloads are included in MXE; this companion is not a fully offline operating-system/compiler build environment.
